basics.name: George W. Clark
basics.label: Assistant Professor of Computer Science
basics.summary: Assistant Professor of Computer Science at the University of South Alabama, specializing in cybersecurity for robotic and cyber-physical systems, hardware security, and side-channel analysis. Senior Member of IEEE, member of ACM, and licensed Professional Engineer in Alabama (inactive).

location.address: University of South Alabama, Suite 1121, Shelby Hall, 150 Student Services Drive

work.name: University of South Alabama
work.summary: Teaching courses in computer architecture, cybersecurity, cyber-physical security, hardware security, and network security. Leading research in robotics cybersecurity, hardware security, and side-channel analysis. Supervising MS thesis students and serving on PhD dissertation committees. Member of Software Protection Exploitation Research Group (SPERG) and Southeastern Consortium for Assured Leading-Edge Semiconductors (SCALES).

work.name: Spring Hill College
work.position: Assistant Professor of Computer Information Systems
work.summary: Taught programming, database management, information systems, and robotics. Developed new curriculum for Introduction to Robotics (CIS 495).
